newsitem.title: SPAIN: Catalan govt sells 9.25 bln ptas of 5-,10-yr bonds.
newsitem.headline: Catalan govt sells 9.25 bln ptas of 5-,10-yr bonds.

text.p: Spain's Catalan regional government allotted 9.25 billion pesetas in five and 10-year bonds in its first auction.
The Generalitat de Catalunya said the five-year 8.10 percent July 2001 bonds gave a yield of 7.136 percent with the minimum price at 106.00.
The 10-year 8.85 percent July 2006 bonds were sold at a yield of 7.905 percent and a price of 108.70 percent.
The total amount bid was 37.25 billion pesetas for the five- year segment and 40.70 billion pesetas for the 10-year bonds, while the allotted volume was respectively 4.75 and 4.5 billion pesetas.
This compares with an offer of 5.0 billion pesetas on each maturity. The next auction is scheduled for November 20.
